settings.text: Inspired by Christmases past, our new Christmas collection finds beauty in the handmade and the heartfelt. From playful papier-mâché baubles to delicately stitched needlepoint stockings, each piece is crafted to bring warmth, texture and a little magic to the season.

Our collection of handcrafted decorations celebrates the quiet artistry of the season. From hand-painted papier-mâché baubles to delicately stitched stockings, each piece is made with time and intention, ready to bring warmth and wonder to every festive corner.

Long before the paper is torn or the ribbons untied, the magic of giving begins here - in the care, the patience, the thought behind every fold and knot. Our handmade wrapping paper and velvet-soft ribbons transform even the simplest gift into something meaningful, a moment to be treasured before the unwrapping begins.

As the days shorten and the celebrations begin, it’s around the table that memories are made. From handcrafted furniture to timeless tableware, our edit is designed for the season of togetherness – of long lunches, candlelit suppers, and the simple pleasure of company.

When loved ones come to stay, it’s the thoughtful touches that make them feel at home. From soft textiles to well-placed lighting and comfortable furniture, our guest room edit is designed to bring comfort, calm, and a quiet sense of care to their stay.
